snippet.title: Luxavia - A Very Short Adventure Game
snippet.description:
Please Subscribe!

Completely Free to Play
Windows: https://www.patreon.com/posts/madewithfusion-133015249
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/au/app/luxavia/id6748031982
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Lux.avi

A new short adventure game by the developer of Anahita! Luxavia is a new adventure game broken down into small little scenes. Can you solve each one to move on to the other. Please note the results are not always what you expect. Please enjoy this free #MadeWithFusion mobile game completely free brought to you by Pershaland the developer of Anahita! 

- 6 scenes in total
- Funny results when solving a scene
- Completely Free
- Let the developer know what you thought of the game!

Developed by Pershaland: https://pershaland.wixsite.com/pershaland

#madewithfusion #indiegame #indiedev #adventure
